name: BreadUp
one_liner: Photograph an object and turn it into optimized commerce; then expand upstream into demand sensing and agent-to-agent selling.
core_thesis: Most people do not want marketplace tooling; they want an object converted into money. A photo can become identification, valuation, sell-speed tradeoff, listing, channel selection, negotiation and P&L. The same commerce engine can later invert the flow by sensing demand first and recommending what to source and sell.
why_now: Multimodal models, marketplace data and agent action surfaces make listing friction compressible.
job: Convert possessions or sourced inventory into sales with minimal manual work.
distribution: Photo-first consumer UX; marketplace integrations; later ChatGPT commerce surface.
moat: Cross-market comp data, sell-through calibration, pricing policy, negotiation traces and reusable commerce adapters.
falsifiers: Valuation confidence is insufficient for users to trust automated listing.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
software_substitution_test.rationale: The moat is not listing software. It is the proprietary trajectory from item evidence through marketplace action to real economic outcome.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Generate the first proprietary sell-through outcome
underengineer.minimal_live_product: One seller photographs one item; BreadUp creates and publishes one listing on one marketplace with approval, then captures the final sale/no-sale outcome, fees and time-to-sale.

steps.action: Accept one photo plus minimal seller corrections
Produce one price/channel recommendation sufficient to list
steps.acceptance: Seller sees price/rationale; no generalized pricing platform required.

steps.action: With seller grant, publish to exactly one marketplace
steps.acceptance: Independent readback returns external listing ID and expected fields.

steps.action: Capture sale or defined expiry/no-sale outcome
steps.acceptance: Realized price, fees and time-to-sale/no-sale are recorded.

underengineer.graduation_rule: At least 10 real item outcomes from consenting sellers, enough to begin testing whether private trajectory data improves decisions.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If sellers will not grant listing authority or the outcome data adds no decision advantage over public comps, change wedge.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.

experiment_strategy.learning_goal: Find which photo-to-money workflow creates real listing/sale outcomes and accumulate sell-through data.
